description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords class in the ai.openclaw.app package. It tests methods like parseCommaSeparated, sanitize, and parseIfChanged.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the WakeWords class, containing multiple test methods to verify its behavior.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that parseCommaSeparated correctly trims whitespace, drops empty entries, and returns the expected list.

methods.name: sanitizeTrimsCapsAndFallsBack
methods.description: Tests that the sanitize method trims whitespace, caps words to maximum length, and falls back to defaults when input is invalid.

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Verifies that sanitize respects the maximum number of words allowed.
